💥 Accidental Wastage
Use for items that are dropped, spilled, spoiled, expired or otherwise completely lost. Stock is removed immediately.
✂️ Yield / Trim Wastage
Use when prep reduces an ingredient's usable weight — trimming fat, removing bones, peeling, butchering. Enter the weight received and yield %, and the system calculates the loss.
🍽️ Staff Meals
Track ingredients used for staff meals separately for food cost reporting. Logged as a staff meal — not counted in customer wastage.
🧪 R&D / Recipe Testing
Test new recipes and deduct ingredients from stock as a R&D trial — tracked separately from wastage. Scan a card or enter manually.

💾 Backing up your data
Everything you enter — inventory, suppliers, recipes, events, and more — saves automatically in this browser as you go. That data lives only on this device, in this browser, so it's worth backing up.

Click Backup Data above to download a JSON file with everything in it. To restore on another device (or after clearing your browser data), open Perpetual Pantries there and click Restore, then choose that file.

⚙️ Alert Settings
Alert when stock falls below this % of par level
Flag the last stocktake as overdue once it's this many days old — set to match how often this client actually wants to count (weekly, fortnightly, monthly, etc.)
How many times an ingredient must be tagged "Recipe/portion variance" before it's flagged as a recurring trend (Stocktake Variance Report's Review button, and Gavin's check_recipe_trends)
How far back Gavin looks for recurring tags — keeps an already-corrected recipe from resurfacing forever off one old tag
While set, every supplier order email (manual, auto-scheduled, and Gavin-sent) goes to this address instead of the real supplier. Clear this before going live.
Optional — PP Command / cloud backend. Leave blank to run fully local.
Generated in PP Command → Sites → Generate link code. Single use, expires in 24h.
Required for Gavin AI assistant and docket scanning. Stored locally in your browser only.
Optional — enables Gavin to pull sales data directly from Lightspeed instead of importing CSVs.
Optional — enables Gavin to query invoices and bills from Xero. Requires OAuth setup.
📤 Data Management
📱 Staff Access — Gavin on Phones
Staff use Gavin_Staff.html on their phones, synced via JSONBin
Setup (once): Create a free account at jsonbin.io, create a new bin, then enter the Bin ID and Master Key below. Push your data, then copy the staff link and share it with your team via WhatsApp or SMS. Staff open Gavin_Staff.html (send them the file once) and paste the link to configure it.
From your jsonbin.io dashboard → Bins
Account Settings → Master Key. Stored locally only.
A dedicated bin where Gavin stores conversation summaries and his action history. Create a new empty bin at jsonbin.io and paste its ID here.
